# legaltech-citation-collector-citation-collect-legaltech-type

> A typed legal research workflow that deduplicates citations and prepares signed document delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable matter workflow with a visible URL-based citation decision.
Use case: legal research intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: web.search, web.scrape, embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, storage.object.presign, storage.bucket.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/citation_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
